note: Updated weekly by scripts/fetch-capabilities.py — do not edit generated_at or source manually

capabilities.name: Ultra Review
capabilities.description: Multi-agent cloud review of your current branch or any GitHub PR — catches bugs, security holes, and missed edge cases across the full diff
capabilities.when_to_use: Before merging any non-trivial PR or before a release
capabilities.note: Billed separately — spawns multiple review agents in parallel. Use /ultrareview <PR#> to review a specific GitHub PR.

capabilities.name: Hooks
capabilities.description: Run any shell command automatically when Claude edits a file, runs bash, or completes a task — use for auto-lint, auto-format, auto-test on every change
capabilities.when_to_use: Any project — prevents Claude from leaving you with un-linted or un-formatted code

capabilities.name: MCP Servers
capabilities.trigger: Settings > MCP Servers in Claude Code
capabilities.description: Connect Claude directly to your database, GitHub, Slack, filesystem, or browser — Claude queries your DB, reads issues, sends messages without copy-pasting
capabilities.when_to_use: When you're constantly copy-pasting query results, API responses, or ticket descriptions into Claude
capabilities.example: mcp-server-postgres → Claude runs SELECT queries on your local DB mid-conversation

capabilities.name: Project Memory (CLAUDE.md)
capabilities.trigger: Create CLAUDE.md in your project root
capabilities.description: Persistent instructions Claude reads every session — define your stack, conventions, commands to never run, team preferences. Eliminates re-explaining context
capabilities.when_to_use: Every project — especially shared ones or any you return to after time away

capabilities.name: Global Memory (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md)
capabilities.description: Global instructions applied to every project across every session — your coding style, preferred tools, things Claude should never do or always do
capabilities.when_to_use: Set once — never explain your global preferences again

capabilities.name: Extended Thinking
capabilities.trigger: Automatic on complex questions, or ask Claude to 'think carefully'
capabilities.description: Claude reasons through hard problems step-by-step before answering — dramatically better for architecture decisions, debugging subtle bugs, security analysis
capabilities.when_to_use: Architecture decisions, tricky bugs, security reviews — ask 'think carefully about...' or switch to Opus

capabilities.name: Parallel Sub-agents
capabilities.trigger: Claude uses automatically — or ask explicitly to 'work in parallel'
capabilities.description: Claude spawns parallel sub-agents for independent tasks — searches multiple files simultaneously, runs parallel research, coordinates multi-step work without blocking
capabilities.when_to_use: Large codebases — Claude explores many files at once instead of reading them one by one

capabilities.name: Fast Mode
capabilities.description: Faster output streaming with the same Claude Opus 4.6 model — not a smaller model. Good for rapid back-and-forth iteration and quick edits
capabilities.when_to_use: When iterating quickly on small changes and you don't need maximum reasoning depth

capabilities.name: IDE Extension (VS Code / JetBrains)
capabilities.trigger: Install 'Claude Code' from VS Code marketplace or JetBrains marketplace
capabilities.description: Claude Code directly inside your editor — inline diffs, apply changes without context switching, see suggestions in the exact file being edited
capabilities.when_to_use: Frontend and TS/JS work — apply component changes without leaving your editor

capabilities.name: GitHub PR Review
capabilities.description: Point Ultra Review at any GitHub PR number — reviews the full diff with multiple agents checking for bugs, security holes, and missed edge cases
capabilities.when_to_use: Team code reviews — drop the PR number, get multi-agent analysis instead of reading the diff yourself

capabilities.name: Custom Skills (Slash Commands)
capabilities.description: Build your own reusable slash commands — document any workflow, Claude reads and follows it. Share with your team via git clone
capabilities.when_to_use: Any repeated workflow — deployment checklists, review protocols, project-specific runbooks

capabilities.name: Permission Modes
capabilities.description: Control what Claude can do autonomously — file edits, bash commands, git operations, network calls. Lock down or open up based on your trust level and task
capabilities.when_to_use: CI/CD pipelines (full auto) or production/sensitive codebases (locked down)

capabilities.name: Web Search
capabilities.trigger: Claude uses automatically when it needs current information
capabilities.description: Claude searches the web for docs, package APIs, error messages, CVEs, Stack Overflow — no more tab-switching to look up library signatures or error codes
capabilities.when_to_use: Working with any external library or debugging errors you haven't seen before

capabilities.name: Image and Screenshot Input
capabilities.trigger: Paste or drag an image into Claude Code chat
capabilities.description: Paste a UI screenshot, error dialog, design mockup, diagram, or whiteboard photo — Claude reads it and acts on it directly
capabilities.when_to_use: Frontend work — paste a Figma screenshot or browser error, get working code back

capabilities.name: Codebase Indexing
capabilities.trigger: Automatic — Claude indexes your project on first use
capabilities.description: Claude builds a semantic index of your codebase — finds relevant files instantly without you specifying paths. The bigger your repo, the more this saves you
capabilities.when_to_use: Large repos — stop specifying file paths, Claude finds what it needs automatically

capabilities.name: Claude Code Web App
capabilities.description: Full Claude Code in the browser — no install needed. Same capabilities as the CLI, useful on machines where you can't install software
capabilities.when_to_use: Remote servers, borrowed machines, or when you want Claude Code without installing anything
